name: gajian
description: GAJIAN: payroll batches with contract-enforced approvals and NEAR testnet wallet payouts

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.samples:check: node scripts/generate-sample-payroll.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- public/templates docs/SAMPLE-DATA.md
scripts.contracts:build: cd contracts && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path smoke/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.contracts:lint: cd contracts && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
